name: Bright Sea Green
lede: Bright Sea Green modifies [[sea-green]] toward full saturation, a name that lives in web color-name lists rather than any painter's palette.

sections.title: A web-list color
sections.body:
The name turns up in Wikipedia's list of web colors and in the xkcd 2010 crowd survey, but not in any of the 29 color books behind this archive, so its origin beyond modifier grammar is undocumented here [1]. Its nearest named neighbor is [[greenish-cyan|Greenish Cyan]], only 3.1 units away and read as duller [2].

The nearest color twin in our gem data is [[gem:aquamarine|aquamarine]], a match close enough to call a real resemblance [3]; on screen, the closest film reference is a green from the title sequence of [[film:vertigo|Vertigo]] (1958) [3]. [[android-green|Weird Green]] sits a little further off, darker by comparison [2].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our 23,781-painting archive carries this color covering at least one percent of its canvas, as photographed [4]. A green this saturated and this light has no real precedent on an aged, varnished surface [4].
